name: Wizard's Tower Suite
description: A impossibly tall tower room that's bigger on the inside (time lord technology or building code violations, hard to say). Spell books float in orbit around a central desk. A cauldron bubbles with something that's either a potion or hotel soup. Crystal balls show different channels. Magical artifacts clutter every surface: wands, orbs, a staff that keeps falling over. The window shows a view of stars that don't exist in this universe. A sign reads: 'Spellcasting after 10 PM will result in additional fees.'
